name: Dog Oasis Grooming Salon
addr: 920 Old Hwy 70 W, Black Mountain, NC 28711

reviews.t: If you are looking for a groomer who does a fantastic job and REALLY cares about your dog then look no further. Set appt times and cage free grooming ensures that your dog gets one on one attn in a very calm atmosphere. Randi is such a kind soul who is so loving and compassionate w/ the dogs. Even the harder to do dogs, traumatized from past experiences of other grooming shops or rescues, she has such patience to make them feel safe and get them groomed and looking great! I totally trust and adore her and you and your dog will too!!! 🙂🙌🏻✨🐶🐾💗
Randi cares so much for your pet! The priority is definitely on the dog's well-being. He wasn't afraid to go there and he looked great when I got him!

Dog Oasis has been taking care of our 75lb golden doodle for I think over 2 years now and we love the service we receive here. They are always booked out a good 4-5 weeks, so plan ahead. They stay so busy because they are so good! Thanks a bunch Randi!!
Randi has been grooming our two Cockers for over 4 years, she treats them as they are her own, all we have to do is say "wanna go see Randi" and they run to the door. Highly recommend Randi
Randy knows dogs & how to treat them well. She makes grooming and bathing as plesent as possible, minimizing anxiety for our fur friends. Randy is the best!

Oasis Grooming does a wonderful job with my 2 large dogs. I have taken them several times now and they are always happy after their grooming. They are not stressed when I pick them up which is the best sign that they have been treated well! So glad I found Dog Oasis Grooming Salon!
Dog Oasis has groomed my Cocker Spaniel for eight years. Always professional and done on schedule.
RANDI is Awesome very respectful my dog looks foward to going to get groomed
Wonderful place great service and great with my dogs.
